notes.title: Quicker Progression & Reset Button Move | Patch
notes.content:
Howdy, here is the first update responding to feedback. Hopefully it will clear some stuff up and make it more fun. If you have any feedback let me know on the discord or steam discussions.

Hope you're enjoying the game!

- Alexandra

notes.title: Response to Feedback | 800$ Raised For Charity!
notes.content:
I've received some reviews about issues in the game and I'll be working on them soon! I'm taking a break for now because of a burnout but I'll get to it soon.

I'll also be working on a content update soon.

We'll also probably will get some translations for some languages by some nice people which is exciting.

We've also raised 800$ for charity, I'll donate the money later when I get the payout from steam.
